svg.data-optics-sfp28: 25G SFP28 SR/LR/ER, 10G SFP+ SR/LR/ER/ZR (datasheet Compatible Transceiver Types; HIG Port Overview gives 1/10/25G on these ports)
svg.data-optics-qsfp28: 100G QSFP28 SR4/LR4/ER4 (datasheet Compatible Transceiver Types; 40/100G with FlexE support)
svg.data-timing: Stratum 3E OCXO; SyncE; IEEE 1588v2 (default, G.8265.1, G.8275.1, G.8275.2, SMPTE ST 2059-2, T-GM, T-BC/OC, T-TC); TSN; Class C accuracy - NOS integration required to activate, and SMPTE ST 2059-2 needs an additional licence (the vendor's own footnotes)
svg.data-gnss: internal receiver for master clock implementations
svg.data-timing-inputs: GNSS SMA in, 10MHz SMB in/out, 1PPS SMB in/out, ToD RJ45 in, BITS RJ48 in/out
svg.data-emc: FCC Part 15 Subpart B Class A; ICES-003 Class A; EN 55032 Class A; EN 300 386; EN 55035; EN 301 489; EN 303 413; EN 62479; EN 50663; VCCI CISPR 32 Class A
svg.data-nebs: NEBS GR-63, GR-1089 and GR-3108 named in the datasheet's Regulatory Compliance section; no NEBS level is claimed there and none is claimed here

g.data-description: HIG GNSS row - Off (not configured), Solid Green (normal state, self-survey complete), Blinking Green (learning state, self-survey not complete), Solid Yellow (power up, not tracking any satellite), Blinking Yellow (antenna short to ground). Every row but Solid Yellow is annotated "need NOS to activate this feature"
g.title: led-gnss

g.data-description: HIG SYNC row - Off (timing synchronization disabled or free-run), Solid Green (timing core, 1588 and SyncE, synchronized to an external source), Blinking Green (synchronized in SyncE mode), Solid Yellow (acquiring state or holdover), Blinking Yellow (synchronization fail)
g.title: led-sync

g.data-description: HIG STAT row - Off (X86 and BMC initializing, or not powered), Solid Green (boot complete), Blinking Green (system is booting). The table lists no yellow for this lamp
g.title: led-stat

g.data-description: HIG FAN row - Off (X86 and BMC initializing, or not powered), Solid Green (all fan modules work well), Blinking Yellow (one or more fan modules fail or no fan module present)
g.title: led-fan

g.data-description: HIG PWR row - Off (no power or shutdown), Solid Green (system power good), Blinking Green (system power good but BMC power fail), Solid Yellow (system power good but CPU power fail), Blinking Yellow (system power fail). Four meanings out of two colours and two behaviours
g.title: led-pwr

g.data-description: BITS input/output on RJ48; HIG Connecting a Cable to the BITS Interface. Drawn with std/rj45-ganged because the shared bezel plate is 14.95 mm wide and 22.42 tall - two 15.8 x 13.2 single-port housings (std/rj45@2) would need 31.6 mm of width side by side and still do not fit in it
g.title: bits

g.data-description: ToD input on RJ45; HIG Connecting a Cable to the ToD Interface - a shielded straight-through cable from a GNSS unit
g.title: tod

g.data-description: the OOB management jack; its two integrated lamps - visible in the front render at x 156.06 and 166.67, and tabled by the HIG as left green for 1G link/activity and right amber for 10M/100M - are drawn as led-a/led-b of this jack
g.title: mgmt

circle.data-states: off ok fail standby no-dc warning
circle.data-description: HIG PSU FRU LED table - Off (no DC power to any PSU), Green (DC output on and OK), Red (PSU failure), Flashing Green (DC present, only standby output on - poor contact), Flashing Red (no DC power to THIS PSU), Flashing between Green and Red (warning: working condition not satisfied, check voltage, current and temperature)

circle.data-states: off ok fail standby no-dc warning
circle.data-description: HIG PSU FRU LED table - Off (no DC power to any PSU), Green (DC output on and OK), Red (PSU failure), Flashing Green (DC present, only standby output on - poor contact), Flashing Red (no DC power to THIS PSU), Flashing between Green and Red (warning: working condition not satisfied, check voltage, current and temperature)
